widgets.text: Swordsman School teaches techniques once you hold Tiger Scrolls: Spin Attack, Roll Attack, Dash Attack, Rock Breaker, Sword Beam, Peril Beam, Down Thrust, Great Spin.
widgets.label: Sword techniques

widgets.text:
Big Green ChuChu (Deepwood Shrine): pull at its base with the Gust Jar until it topples, then slash.
Gleerok (Cave of Flames): Cane of Pacci and sword on its exposed back/head.
Mazaal (Fortress of Winds): break the hands, then shrink to Minish size to get inside.
Big Octorok (Temple of Droplets): ice and Lantern puzzles; hit its back.
Gyorg pair (Palace of Winds): Roc's Cape between them and strike the eye.
Vaati (Dark Hyrule Castle): split into copies with the Four Sword.
